name: WWWA Unified World Championship
epitaph: Never awarded: its own sixteen-man tournament reached the final four before the promotion folded without running the pay-per-view meant to crown a first champion.

name: WWWA American Championship
epitaph: Announced alongside the promotion's other two titles in its own founding handbook, but never contested in any surviving document.

name: WWWA World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Announced alongside the promotion's other two titles in its own founding handbook, but never contested in any surviving document.
